title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00382063778168 (+0.00003312268681 over #7726) with grouped P104 helpers
body:
## Conditional bound

This construction gives **κ ≥ 0.00382063778168** under the five inherited compiler assumptions. It clears the upper price endpoint of #7726 by **0.00003312268681** (0.87452%). The increment reported for #7726 was 0.00002437823416. The new increment is **35.87% larger**. The scientific result is in commit `9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417`. [Construction and exact receipts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures)

| Circuit and caller | Certified κ | Raw crossing interval |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| #7726 with its 16-call caller | 0.00378751509478 | [0.00378751509486, 0.00378751509487] |
| New circuit with the original caller | **0.00381302461201** | [0.00381302461209, 0.00381302461210] |
| New circuit with the new 1,024-call caller | **0.00382063778168** | [0.00382063778176, 0.00382063778177] |

The native circuit removes 66 old paid transfers and adds two. The per-call paid count falls **5,810 → 5,746**. It serves 400 main fields and 862 independent helpers. The journal changes the basis of transfers with common endpoints, then lets several helpers enter and leave together. In the worked example, charts 144 and 177 observe different source equations. Their responses to both incoming disturbances recover both outputs. The verifier derives both equations from the local banks. [Native proof and worked example](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/PROOF.md)

A new thirty-field root mixes fourteen A contacts with two B contacts. A finite schedule binds every main input and pays for the change of head direction and phase at every physical port. The 1,024-call bill contains **6,080,992 paid jobs** (197,088 caller and 5,883,904 native) and **1,092,864 productive jobs** (210,176 root owners and 882,688 independent native helper owners). The caller alone on the parent circuit has a raw crossing in [0.00379502629537, 0.00379502629538]. [Caller proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/MIXED-PROOF.md) · [Complete bills](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/results/application.json)

## Task, scope and overlap

Task `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 8. The canonical main base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The comparison uses the exact #7726 scientific commit `3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3`. The refined scope is simultaneous source and return equations at different native charts, plus an explicit caller for the altered boundary. #7727 provides banked search tools. #7748 studies a signed gather on a fixed C56 flag. The #7750 and #7751 BIT arrival results use fixed deadlines. The paid graph and the complete caller here supply different evidence. [Task record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/TASK.json) · [Investigation and overlap](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19718386)

## Verification and limits

The six registered checks pass under CPython 3.12.16 on macOS arm64. They expand all 32 native edits over the rationals, check the reversed operator on all 1,262 public fields and verify the 2,946 surviving phased chart pairs. They check the caller templates symbolically and recover all 17,777,792 chronological instructions. Two modular character probes execute that stream and recover the required signed outputs for all 210,176 root owners. Altered source responses, contact phases and insufficient grids fail their controls. The interval gate checks both price signs, 54 strict predicates, four functional predicates and the depth guard. The ordinary BIT pin of 0.00385248 leaves 0.00003184221832 above the new point. The fixed invoice crosses within 0.00000000000009 of it. [Commands and checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/VERIFY.json)

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures --check-source-history --check-modes
```

The five inherited assumptions cover native all-column application, owned erasure, the recursive compiler, precision and tape accounting, and analytic recovery. Independent scientific review remains open. The selected record on the base is 0.00363005817. A separate commit carries ToikY and Clear1nsight's existing #7257 CI repair. On the base, the selected-navigation test expects the #7000 command and the guide points to #6030. All six navigation tests pass with the shared repair. [Selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/certificates/selected-result.json) · [CI-only commit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/commit/6b0044123aad114cf71ca2bb0e98741e5a27c7b5)

## Credit and open questions

Ali Romman prepared this contribution with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. It builds on Clear1nsight's causal splits and physical engine, DreamingOfClouds and Claude's literal splits, banked toolkit and signed-curvature checks, SYLforge's signed word, Rohan Arun's mirrored caller, and the selected framework of Jerry Chen / CubeJerry and Douglas Colkitt. The package retains predecessor notices and source hashes. [Credit and source lineage](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/CREDITS.md)

An independent reviewer can start with group 26, recover the two observed equations from the six local banks at each chart, and check that both terminal disturbances cancel. A second review can reconstruct the common head on all sixteen visits of one mixed root and charge both changes of view. [Open next questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/README.md#open-next-questions)
